manual_intro: A quick reference for the basics. For the full guide, FAQ, and troubleshooting, see the online Wiki (link at the bottom).
manual_sec_download_body:
1. Open the Video or Music tab.
2. Paste one or more URLs, one per line — batches are supported.
3. Pick a format and quality.
4. Choose a save location.
5. Click Start Download.

Supports 500+ sites via yt-dlp: YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, BiliBili, Twitter, SoundCloud, Twitch, Vimeo, and more.
manual_sec_convert_body: Enter one or more file paths, choose a format and output location, then select a collision policy. The web app uses files already on the server; it does not upload files.
manual_sec_cookies_body: Choose a browser or provide a cookies.txt path. In the web app, both refer to the server's environment.
manual_sec_log_body: The log shows download and conversion events. Filter or search the entries and export a copy when needed.
manual_sec_ai_body: Open the AI Assistant and describe tasks using specific URLs or file paths. Review the complete plan before confirming. The app keeps a session-only key in memory; previously saved keys remain in local storage. The web app sends the key and prompt to its server and then OpenRouter.
manual_sec_settings_body: Switch the interface language from the dropdown in the header — English, 繁體中文, or 简体中文. Click the sun/moon icon to cycle Light → Dark → System theme.
manual_sec_help_body:

log_clear_confirm_body: This removes every line currently shown. It can't be undone (export it first if you need a copy).
log_hint_outdated: [{i}/{t}]  ⚠  Repeated 403 errors usually mean the bundled downloader is out of date. Please update to the latest version of the app.
download_playlist_count_note: Preview a playlist to review and select individual videos. Direct playlist downloads still include the whole playlist; multi-line input rows count as input URLs.
playlist_preview_hint: This reads playlist metadata only and does not download media.
playlist_preview_one_url: Enter exactly one URL to preview a playlist.
playlist_preview_mock_unavailable: Real playlist preview needs the app or its local web server; this browser preview has no backend.
playlist_preview_failed: Playlist preview failed. Check the URL, cookies, and access.
playlist_preview_unavailable: {count} playlist entries could not be listed.
playlist_preview_truncated: Only the first {limit} entries are shown. A direct playlist download still includes all entries.
video_encoder_hint: Software keeps FFmpeg's default video encoder selection. Hardware choices apply only to video streams and MP4, MKV, or MOV output. They require a compatible GPU and FFmpeg build; availability is not detected. If a conversion needs an unavailable selected hardware encoder, it fails without software fallback.
video_encoder_unsupported_format: Hardware encoding supports MP4, MKV, and MOV output only. Choose Software or a supported output format.
manual_sec_convert_body_upload: Enter one or more file paths, choose a format and output location, then select a collision policy. On the web, uploads are optional and disabled until a server administrator sets the limits; uploaded and interrupted data remain on the server.
event_connection_failed: The event stream could not connect. Reload the app before starting a task.
event_connecting: Connecting to the event stream. New tasks are unavailable until it connects.
event_disconnected: The event stream is disconnected. Existing tasks can still be stopped; progress events may be missing.
event_gap_warning: Some events may have been missed while disconnected. Final task results are reported separately.
operation_state_unknown: The operation, stop, or reservation state could not be confirmed. A task may still be running; an unused reservation may remain busy until it expires, up to 120 seconds.
operation_result_lost: The operation terminated, but its final result was lost. Success cannot be confirmed.
operation_result_unknown: The original backend instance is idle, but the operation result is unknown. Success cannot be confirmed.
operation_response_error: The operation terminated and an error response was received. Check the message and verify any output files.
operation_not_started: The operation did not start; its reservation was released.
preview_snapshot_hint: This is a snapshot; paths and conflicts may change before execution.
ai_preview_snapshot_hint: This snapshot does not reserve outputs or guarantee final names. Files and conflicts may change before execution.
preview_batch_duplicate: May share a destination with another item
preview_source_matches: Destination matches a source in this batch
preview_failed: The conversion preview could not be loaded.
operation_failed: Failed {failed} of {total} items; check the log.
operation_unknown: The operation ended without a valid summary. Check the log.
conversion_result_unreliable: Conversion results are inconsistent or unavailable. Check existing output files before trying again.
queue_result_unreliable: Queue results are inconsistent or unavailable. Check existing output files before trying again.
web_upload_intro: Enter server file paths, or upload a local file when enabled.
web_upload_config_error: Upload availability could not be verified.
web_upload_limits: Maximum per file: {file} bytes. Server retention capacity: {total} bytes; current free capacity is not shown.
web_upload_retention: Completed and interrupted uploads remain on the server. Retrying may create another retained copy; no automatic cleanup is provided.
web_upload_naming: The server stores uploads under a generated name; converted output uses that name.
web_upload_completed: Upload completed and was added to the conversion list.
web_upload_invalid_file: This file name or size is not accepted by the upload limits.
web_upload_unconfirmed: Upload was not confirmed. Completed or partial data may remain on the server; check it before trying again.
web_upload_cancelled: Upload stopped. Completed or partial data may remain on the server; check it before trying again.
web_upload_reason_not_configured: Upload limits have not been configured.
web_upload_reason_insufficient_total: The server retention limit is too small.
web_upload_reason_unsupported_platform: This server platform does not support safe uploads.
web_upload_stop_notice: Stopping cancels this browser's requests; an in-flight request may still complete on the server.
web_upload_slot_accounting: Slots are single-use and never reclaimed automatically. The configured total is an application accounting limit for file content, journal, and fixed metadata, not a disk-usage limit.
web_upload_enabled_note: Enabled means the configuration is valid; the first upload can still fail.
web_upload_reason_windows_local_only: Uploads currently require Windows and a verified local fixed or removable drive.
stop_not_active: No stoppable task is active yet. Try again if needed.
cookie_local_path_invalid: Enter an absolute cookie file path for this system, or leave the field blank.
convert_paths_web: Enter files already on the server, relative to its downloads folder. File upload is not available.
convert_paths_desktop: Enter full local file paths, one per line. A native file picker is not available.

native_path_rejected: Some dropped items did not provide full paths and were not added.

conflict_overwrite_confirm: Existing output files may be replaced. Continue with overwrite?
